title: BioKGSuite: a multidimensional evaluation framework for biomedical knowledge graphs
description: Code, configuration, analysis notebooks and result tables for BioKGSuite, which evaluates biomedical knowledge graphs across seven quality dimensions and 19 metrics, applied to six knowledge graphs for drug repurposing, together with a prospective experiment grounding large language models in knowledge-graph evidence. Knowledge graphs and third-party reference data are not included; the pipeline downloads them at pinned releases.
